engineering-chemistry--cfse.title: CFSE and spin state for d^n ions (octahedral)
engineering-chemistry--cfse.note: Values follow 0.4 n_t2g minus 0.6 n_eg, positive meaning net stabilisation; the pairing energy P is not included.

engineering-chemistry--spectrochemical-s.title: spectrochemical series in octahedral complexes
engineering-chemistry--spectrochemical-s.note: Only the strong-field end flips a d4 to d7 ion to low spin, because Δo must exceed the pairing energy P.

engineering-chemistry--nernst-equation.title: Nernst equation from Gibbs energy
engineering-chemistry--nernst-equation.note: The 0.0592 V form is only the 298 K version, so a temperature change moves the slope of the log term.

engineering-chemistry--degree-of-polymer.title: Carothers relation: conversion to chain length
symbols: molar mass of one repeat unit
engineering-chemistry--degree-of-polymer.note: Step-growth chains grow only at high conversion, so reaching DP 100 already needs 99% of the functional groups reacted.

engineering-chemistry--corrosion.title: forms of corrosion and control
rows: two dissimilar metals in one electrolyte
avoid dissimilar couples, insulate the joint
local breakdown of the passive film
cut chloride, keep surface clean, add Mo
oxygen starvation inside a shielded gap
seal the gap or redesign it out
tensile stress plus a specific ion
direct attack by oxygen at high temperature
Cr or Al alloying, protective oxide
fast fluid strips the protective film
engineering-chemistry--corrosion.note: Cathodic protection only works while the protected metal stays the cathode, so a sacrificial anode is consumed instead.

engineering-chemistry--desalination.title: reverse-osmosis desalination
engineering-chemistry--desalination.note: The pump must beat the osmotic pressure of seawater, about 27 bar, so water is forced against its natural flow.
